subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core TUI config, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses public config, TUI rendering, provider usage/auth, and Plugin SDK boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term product/API contract.

options.title: Plugin/API-First Footer Seam
options.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add a TUI render path and provider-usage fields after ordering, truncation, caching, and field shape are approved.

options.title: Core Config Template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui` footer template/config surface and accept the compatibility and migration burden of a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep Existing Status Surfaces
options.body: Keep `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and related status surfaces as the supported quota/cost visibility path and do not add persistent footer customization now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-First Footer Seam
recommendation.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add a TUI render path and provider-usage fields after ordering, truncation, caching, and field shape are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: History connects steipete to the provider-usage/status seam and plugin API boundary decisions that shape this product tradeoff.
